engine_name: Saved Calculator Results Over Time: per-calculator headline saving (headline, unit, band, engine version; encrypted inputs for Stage 3 calculators only), 'change since last check' wording with meaningful-change thresholds (D3-34), heart-risk lab versus non-lab comparability and earlier-version notes, and a 91-day re-check reminder with a generic email line (D3-35)
intended_use: Lets a member save a calculator's headline result and, with Premium, see the history, how it has changed since the last check and a 3-monthly re-check reminder. Saving a headline is free (with health consent); history, re-check reminders and comparisons are Premium. It does not diagnose any condition.
eligibility: Members with health consent. Stage 1 tools (protein, diabetes, healthy weight) keep their Stage 2 behaviour: headline, unit, band, version only; inputs are never stored (D51). Eating-disorder flag (FR3-69): calorie_target and goal_timeline results are never shown and none are created; healthy_weight and metabolic are shown without weight-loss wording. Re-check reminders for heart_risk, bp_check, metabolic, fitness_age and healthy_weight only; never for calorie_target or goal_timeline, and never for a calculator the safety matrix now hides for the member.
sources: Stage 2 requirements FR2-23 and data model C4 (saved results), decision D51.
Minimal clinically important differences used for the thresholds: ISH home BP day-to-day variability (~5 mmHg); Nes 2011 SEE (5.1-5.7 mL/kg/min); NICE NG246 BMI rounding (D55).
limitations: Below the meaningful-change threshold the result is 'about the same', so noise is not presented as a trend.
Heart risk lab versus non-lab results are not directly comparable: no better/worse label.
Results from different engine versions are always compared, with the version noted.
HR zones has no comparison (changes only with age).
Reminder emails carry no health numbers and do not name the calculator (D3-35); the calculator is named only on the page after sign-in.
regulatory_statement: Approved by the owner as clinical reviewer on 3 November 2026 (P3-5B, FR3-55, NFR3-14, NFR3-17). General health information, not a diagnosis or a medical device.
licence: Lifeline Daily's own rules built on Stage 2 saved results (FR2-23, D51) and published minimal clinically important differences.

clinical_signoff.name: Product owner (sudarshanalk), acting as clinical reviewer
clinical_signoff.notes: Signed 3 November 2026 ('Approve all, D3-10 = B', in chat with the clinical session; record Signoff-P3-5B-Saved-Results-Over-Time.md). D3-33: Stage 3 calculators store encrypted inputs so re-checks pre-fill; Stage 1 tools keep Stage 2 behaviour (D51). D3-34 thresholds: protein 5 g; diabetes risk 1 point; BMI 0.5; calorie target 50 kcal; heart risk 1 point or a band change; BP 5 systolic or 3 diastolic; metabolic 1 criterion; VO2 1.5; fitness age 2 years; stress score 2; sleep count 1. D3-35: generic re-check email ('a calculator re-check is due'), calculator named only after sign-in. Lab vs non-lab heart risk 'not directly comparable'; different engine versions compared with a note. Wording 'Better / Higher than last time / About the same'; never praise for kilograms lost (FR3-16 AS-04). Save and latest result Free with health consent; history, comparisons and re-check reminders Premium; downgrade keeps history (FR3-68). Re-check 91 days after the last saved result for heart risk, BP check, metabolic, fitness age, healthy weight. Copy hashes: change.lower is the fragment 'Lower than last time' as the sheet gives it (fitness); recheck.email is the D3-35 decided generic line, which supersedes the sheet's example that names the calculator.
